name: South Fork Snake (Canyon)
blurb: South Fork Snake canyon and downstream valley floats, with public access at Conant, Fullmer, Byington and Lorenzo. Choose the full canyon or a shorter reach through Fullmer.

sections.notes: A long canyon float. Fullmer at river mile 28 provides an intermediate public ramp; arrange your shuttle and allow time for stops. Use designated camps and the required overnight permit if breaking the trip over multiple days.

sections.notes: A shorter canyon option ending at the public Fullmer ramp. Confirm the Fullmer road and shuttle beforehand; its map marker is the parking area above the river.
